name: Doushite Ijiwaru Suru no?
original_name: どうしていじわるするの?
source:
At a storehouse of the gymnasium afterschool...

I am bullied by a schoolboy...

I wear a school swimsuit under my school uniform
by his order... He will come here soon...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ204487.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
